package proto

import (
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// Item 3: GC stops a C loop that calls nothing but the back-edge poll. The
// workers run spin, whose only Go call is host_poll every 10000 back edges.
func TestGCStopsSpinLoop(t *testing.T) {
	interruptRequested.Store(0)
	gcStopRun("C spin loop (poll every 10000 back edges)", 150, func(n int, stop <-chan struct{}) func() {
		var wg sync.WaitGroup
		for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
			wg.Add(1)
			go func() {
				defer wg.Done()
				for {
					select {
					case <-stop:
						return
					default:
						spin(0, 20_000_000)
					}
				}
			}()
		}
		return wg.Wait
	})
}

// The same with a poll every 545000 back edges, about the 240 µs between
// polls of the current engine's JS loop on the test machine.
func TestGCStopsSpinLoopSlowPoll(t *testing.T) {
	interruptRequested.Store(0)
	gcStopRun("C spin loop (poll every 545000 back edges)", 150, func(n int, stop <-chan struct{}) func() {
		var wg sync.WaitGroup
		for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
			wg.Add(1)
			go func() {
				defer wg.Done()
				for {
					select {
					case <-stop:
						return
					default:
						spin_every(0, 50_000_000, 545_000)
					}
				}
			}()
		}
		return wg.Wait
	})
}

// Item 6: an interrupt requested during the loop is observed at the poll and
// the loop ends early.
func TestInterruptLatched(t *testing.T) {
	interruptRequested.Store(0)
	interruptLatched.Store(0)
	done := make(chan int64, 1)
	go func() { done <- spin(0, 5_000_000_000) }()
	time.Sleep(10 * time.Millisecond)
	interruptRequested.Store(1)
	select {
	case <-done:
	case <-time.After(5 * time.Second):
		t.Fatal("spin did not end after the interrupt")
	}
	if interruptLatched.Load() != 1 {
		t.Fatal("the interrupt was not latched at the poll")
	}
	interruptRequested.Store(0)
}

// TestSpinPeriod times one iteration of spin, so the time between two polls
// (10000 back edges) can be read off.
func TestSpinPeriod(t *testing.T) {
	interruptRequested.Store(0)
	const n = 20_000_000
	best := time.Duration(1 << 62)
	for r := 0; r < 5; r++ {
		t0 := time.Now()
		spin(0, n)
		if d := time.Since(t0); d < best {
			best = d
		}
	}
	println("C spin:", float64(best)/n, "ns per iteration")
}
